description: Completely removes ads: banners and interstitials can never be displayed (CFirebaseAds.showBanners/showInterstitial become no-ops) and ad-free is granted once per app start — loadStore() seeds mAdFree = 1, the native engine's poll grants it and the store's own reset (inappPurchasesProcessed) zeroes the field, so no repeated purchase popups.
name: Hill Climb Racing Ad Removal

description: Every store item is granted instantly and free: coins, gems, paints, ad-skips, ad-free and bundles, without launching Google Play billing.
name: Hill Climb Racing Free Store

description: Rewarded video ads grant their reward instantly without playing the ad: the native engine receives onVideoStartedSuccess + onVideoCompletedSuccess on the GL thread, exactly as if the video had been watched and completed.
name: Hill Climb Racing Instant Rewarded Video Rewards

description: Hides all LINE Yahoo Premium (LYP) surfaces: the upsells, the badges, the Premium settings page, and the subscribe and manage flows. Premium chat backup changes to the ordinary chat-history backup. This patch unlocks nothing, because the server enforces premium.
name: Disable LINE Premium

description: VOOM deep links, shares, and notifications do nothing. If you open the standalone VOOM feed, it closes. Messaging and the other tabs do not change.
name: Disable VOOM

description: Sends the Google account picker and the Drive token of chat-history backup through GmsCore. Backup and restore then work on a re-signed build. This patch needs MicroG-RE. It does not change how you sign in to a Google account. A Root Mount install does not need this patch.
name: Fix chat backup sign-in via GmsCore

description: When LINE is fully closed, push notifications work again on a re-signed build. A Root Mount install does not need this patch.
name: Fix push notifications

description: Hides the LINE display ad views. These are the LINE Ads SDK containers in the whole app, the chat-list Smart Channel banner, and the Google AdManager ads.
name: Hide ad views

description: Removes all the server-provided extra tools from the + attach menu in a chat room (Poll, Reservation, Schedule, Ladder shuffle, and more). The built-in tiles (camera, gallery, files, and contact) do not change.
name: Hide attach menu extra tools

description: Removes every LINE Calendar surface inside the messenger. One is in the Chats-tab header. Four are in a chat room: the top toolbar, the + attach menu, the slide-out chat menu, and the message long-press menu. The last is the Calendar block in the Friends sub-tab of the Home tab.
name: Hide calendar buttons

description: Removes the community (OpenChat) button from the top of the Chats tab header.
name: Hide community button

description: Removes the "Events" row from the slide-out menu in a chat room. Events is a different feature from LINE Calendar, and it opens a server-hosted page.
name: Hide Events button

description: Removes the content feed below the friends list on the Home tab. The feed shows LINE NEWS posts, official account posts, live cards, content units, and ranking units. The friends list, the service icons, and the other Home modules do not change.
name: Hide Home content feed

description: Hides clutter modules on the Home tab: the recommended stickers and content section, the real-time hot-topics (即時夯話題) block, and the ad modules. A separate patch hides the content feed below the friends list.
name: Hide Home modules

description: Removes the LINE GIFT tile from the + attach menu in a chat room.
name: Hide LINE GIFT button

description: Removes the LINE TODAY (News) tab from the main bottom navigation, in both the news-tab and news-row layouts.
name: Hide LINE TODAY tab

description: Hides the green dots and N badges that mark new items, on header buttons, tabs, menus, lists and settings rows. Unread message counts do not change.
name: Hide new item badges

description: Removes the LYP premium-unsend upsells that stay after "Disable LINE Premium". These are the "Unsend discreetly" button, the post-unsend promo link, and the expired-window unsend upsell. Ordinary unsend still works.
name: Hide premium unsend upsells

description: Removes the Shopping tab from the main bottom navigation. This includes the Japan variant (Shopping, ショッピング) and the Taiwan variant (Discover, 逛逛).
name: Hide Shopping tab

description: Removes the Transfer (LINE Pay) tile from the + attach menu in a chat room.
name: Hide Transfer button

description: Removes the VOOM (formerly Timeline) tab from the main bottom navigation.
name: Hide VOOM tab

description: Removes the Wallet (LINE Pay) tab from the main bottom navigation, in both the normal and mini-tab layouts.
name: Hide Wallet tab

description: When you open a 1:1 or group chat, LINE does not mark it read and sends no read receipt. If you use "Mark as read" or "Mark all as read", LINE marks the chat read and sends the receipt.
name: Keep chats unread

description: Keeps unsent messages from 1:1 and group chats on your device instead of erasing them. This patch shows the usual "unsent a message" notice directly below the message that it kept. This patch does not apply to OpenChat.
name: Keep unsent messages

description: When you tap a web link (http or https), it opens in your default browser instead of LINE's in-app browser. LIFF mini-apps and LINE deep links do not change.
name: Open links in external browser

description: Opens LINE Pay flows in the standalone LINE Pay app instead of inside LINE. The device-integrity check that fails on a re-signed build never runs. Messaging does not change.
name: Redirect LINE Pay

description: LINE no longer loads the Smart Channel banner ads. This patch makes the getBanners and getPrefetchableBanners responses null.
name: Remove banner ads

description: Claims the channel points bonus chest for you automatically. Whenever Twitch makes a bonus available, the claim fires on its own so you don't have to tap the chest.
name: Auto claim channel points

description: Routes live streams through a free third-party proxy that strips the ads baked into the stream, so the proxy has to be up for playback to work; turn this patch off if it goes down. Mid-stream ads get dropped reliably, but a single preroll can still slip through when you first open a channel and Twitch has flagged the shared proxy. VOD ads aren't covered.
name: Block live ads

description: Hides the banner with the frog that prompts you to buy Tumblr Ad-Free.
name: Disable ad-free banner

description: Stops the reminder asking you to enable notifications for blogs you visit.
name: Disable blog notification reminder

description: Stops the popup that suggests buying TumblrMart items for other people.
name: Disable gift message popup

description: Turns off the in-app update check and the update prompt.
name: Disable in-app update

description: Removes the Tumblr TV tab from the bottom navigation bar.
name: Disable Tumblr TV

description: Unlocks BlockerHero's premium features without a subscription or Google sign-in, like uninstall protection, focus mode, custom blocklists, daily and weekly time limits, and more.
name: Enable Premium

description: Turns on the cosmetic Tumblr Premium look: the premium badge and the premium settings entry. This only changes how the app looks on your device. It does not buy or unlock anything on Tumblr's side, so ad-free, the badge on your blog, and anything the server checks still need a real subscription. Use "Remove ads" for an actually ad-free feed.
name: Enable premium UI
